script.text: A new company has just been registered. For now, it's an empty plot.
It takes on premises: that's property and contents cover.
Its first employees: employers' liability, which is required by law.
And when it opens to customers: public liability.
Every new asset is a new policy. And new and growing companies need that cover before they start trading.
We find new and expanding companies in public registers and on their own websites, with the director's name and contact details.
Every Monday, as a PDF and a spreadsheet. Each lead goes to one broker only.
Start with ten free leads from across the UK, at nextgen-profit dot de.
